SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_end_date, ref.period_start_date, ref.period_end_date, ref.fully_loaded,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (f.store_key, f.product_key)) AS n_distinct_keys,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads,
       SUM(f.closing_value) AS raw_value
FROM fact_stock_week f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar ref ON ref.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year AND ref.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, p.sku, cp.category AS cur_cat, p.category AS asof_cat, f.closing_units, f.closing_value, f.store_key, f.product_key, p.standard_unit_cost, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT fiscal_week, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_id, sku)) nat, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) skus,
 SUM(closing_value) v, SUM(CASE WHEN asof_cat<>cur_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) catdiff,
 SUM(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(closing_value - closing_units*standard_unit_cost)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) valmismatch
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND store_id <> 999),
wk AS (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3),
cnt AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.closing_value) v
  FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT st.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.close_date, cs.open_date,
  MAX(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_week=9 THEN c.n END) w9, MAX(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_week=10 THEN c.n END) w10,
  MAX(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_week=11 THEN c.n END) w11, MAX(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_week=12 THEN c.n END) w12,
  MAX(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_week=13 THEN c.n END) w13
FROM stores st CROSS JOIN wk w LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.fiscal_week=w.fiscal_week
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=st.store_id AND cs.is_current
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY st.store_id

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
    AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly

WITH w AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, p.sku, f.closing_units, f.closing_value, f.adjustment_units, f.receipts_units, cp.delisted_on
  FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id<900)
SELECT a.sku, COUNT(*) n, SUM(a.closing_units) units9, SUM(a.closing_value) val9, MIN(a.delisted_on) delisted, MIN(a.adjustment_units) minadj
FROM w a WHERE a.fiscal_week=9 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM w b WHERE b.fiscal_week=10 AND b.store_id=a.store_id AND b.sku=a.sku)
GROUP BY 1
